create_ApplyExplicitAttentionMask: create an ApplyExplicitAttentionMask layer that applies an explicit attention mask to input logits using a side input mask array
build_ApplyCausalAttentionMask: build an ApplyCausalAttentionMask layer that constructs and applies a causal attention mask based on token positions
run_ApplyCausalSlidingWindowAttentionMas: run an ApplyCausalSlidingWindowAttentionMask layer that applies a sliding-window causal mask to limit attention context
create_Attention: create an Attention layer that maps inputs to queries, keys, and values and combines them into an output via attention weights
build_KVCachingAttention: build a KVCachingAttention layer from an existing Attention layer to enable key-value caching for autoregressive inference
